mapper.select: SELECT TO_CHAR(ib.sku_id) || ':' || COALESCE(TO_CHAR(ib.allocated_sales_point_id), 'UNASSIGNED') AS scope_key FROM inventory_balance ib LEFT JOIN risk_assessment ra ON ra.inventory_balance_id = ib.inventory_balance_id AND ra.is_deleted = 0 WHERE ib.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY ib.sku_id, ib.allocated_sales_point_id HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN ra.rule_version = #{ruleVersion} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 ORDER BY scope_key

WITH latest_forecast AS ( SELECT forecast_id, sku_id, sales_point_id, base_date, predicted_qty_d7, predicted_qty_d30, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sku_id, sales_point_id ORDER BY base_date DESC, forecast_id DESC) AS rn FROM demand_forecast WHERE is_deleted = 0 ), latest_policy AS ( SELECT sku_id, allocated_sales_point_id AS sales_point_id, safety_stock_qty, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sku_id, allocated_sales_point_id ORDER BY effective_from DESC, inventory_policy_id DESC) AS rn FROM inventory_policy WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND (effective_from IS NULL OR effective_from <= #{asOfDate}) AND (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to >= #{asOfDate}) ) SELECT ib.inventory_balance_id, ib.sku_id, ib.allocated_sales_point_id AS sales_point_id, lf.forecast_id, s.sku_code, COALESCE(sp.sales_point_code, 'UNASSIGNED') AS sales_point_code, ib.on_hand_qty, lf.predicted_qty_d7, lf.predicted_qty_d30, lp.safety_stock_qty, lf.base_date AS forecast_base_date, TO_CHAR(l.lot_id) AS lot_id, l.lot_no AS lot_number, l.expiry_date, l.sale_stop_date, l.received_date, l.lot_status, ib.on_hand_qty AS lot_qty FROM inventory_balance ib JOIN sku s ON s.sku_id = ib.sku_id AND s.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sales_point sp ON sp.sales_point_id = ib.allocated_sales_point_id AND sp.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN latest_forecast lf ON lf.sku_id = ib.sku_id AND (lf.sales_point_id = ib.allocated_sales_point_id OR (lf.sales_point_id IS NULL AND ib.allocated_sales_point_id IS NULL)) AND lf.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN latest_policy lp ON lp.sku_id = ib.sku_id AND (lp.sales_point_id = ib.allocated_sales_point_id OR (lp.sales_point_id IS NULL AND ib.allocated_sales_point_id IS NULL)) AND lp.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN lot l ON l.lot_id = ib.lot_id AND l.is_deleted = 0 WHERE ib.is_deleted = 0 AND (TO_CHAR(ib.sku_id) || ':' || COALESCE(TO_CHAR(ib.allocated_sales_point_id), 'UNASSIGNED')) IN #{scopeKey}
